title: Patching: window, testing, rollout and exceptions

videos.script: Installing an update takes a minute. Patching is everything around that minute. {{tension}} The portal has to stay up. The flaw has to be closed by its date. Patching is the arrangement that lets both be true. {{repo}} You will build a repository of the firm's own, and publish two versions of a package. {{rings}} The update goes to one machine first. Only when that one is still fine does it reach the portal. {{auto}} Then the updates nobody has to type, and the one machine that must not get them yet. {{back}} And when an update goes wrong, you take it out again, faster than it went in.
